text: Acceptance completed 2026-08-03. Added FactorLevelSet.fromEnum[A] as a compile-time Mirror-derived entrance that expands to the same validated FactorLevelSet.from constructor and preserves enum source order; no parallel schema algebra or cast was introduced. Documented Event.factor as a single-table convenience that cannot serve as cross-run/subject schema authority. Existing evidence covers declared order, duplicate/unknown levels, numeric coding, row permutation, run/subject schema incompatibility, RetainZero/Omit/Reject receipts, mixed-run audit, and declared-empty contrast diagnostics. Gates: EventModelBuilderParitySuite 35/35 JVM and JS; ModelBuilderSuite 10/10 JVM and JS; StructuralHypothesisSuite 9/9 JVM and JS; design compile JVM/JS; canonical first-level gate already green.
